references.caption:
Vista de la obra en construcción para la Cárcel de Encausados de Buenos Aires. Inaugurada finalmente en 1979, se conocería como Cárcel de Caseros.
El proyecto original, que contemplaba también el edificio de los Tribunales, no fue concretado. La cárcel fue demolida en 2004.

originalReview.notes: Personally inspected exact published1969 original: whole already raised concrete twin-tower structural mass, deep grid and horizontally banded faces, upper open colonnade/crown/mechanical head, stepped low podium. It is construction-state evidence; no claim that it proves final1979 cladding, rear elevations or precise plan dimensions. Adjacent low prison/neighborhood and unbuilt judicial maquette are not substituted.

excludedHistoricalImagery.reason: Partly unbuilt judicial scheme and underlying model/design binding unresolved; not used.

notes: One exact native-byte published PD construction photograph adopted. No other native category image used; CC BY/CC BY-SA and replacement-building images excluded. No rights guard or corpus metadata changed. Whole-building draft remains unaccepted.
